cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：大声的
cards.example_en: The loud music from next door kept the baby awake.
cards.example_zh: 隔壁大声的音乐吵得宝宝睡不着。

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.example_en: She was in luck and found a seat on the crowded bus.
cards.example_zh: 她运气不错，在拥挤的公交车上找到了座位。

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：男性的
cards.example_en: The male swimmers lined up at the pool's deep end.

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.example_en: The ferry is the only means of reaching the island school.
cards.example_zh: 渡船是去岛上那所学校的唯一手段。

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.example_en: The bitter medicine worked, and her fever fell by evening.
cards.example_zh: 这苦药起了作用，到傍晚她的烧退了。

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.example_en: A wild mushroom grew beside the path after three rainy days.
cards.example_zh: 连着下了三天雨以后，小路边长出了一朵野蘑菇。

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.example_en: The scarf slipped from her neck when she ran for the bus.
cards.example_zh: 她追公交车时，围巾从脖子上滑了下来。

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.example_en: The nurse cleaned the cut and told him to rest.
cards.example_zh: 护士清洗了伤口，让他休息。

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：奇怪的
cards.example_en: An odd noise came from the fridge at midnight.
cards.example_zh: 半夜冰箱里传来一阵奇怪的响声。

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.example_en: We waited nervously for the outcome of the singing contest.
cards.example_zh: 我们紧张地等待歌唱比赛的结果。

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.example_en: Sudden pain in his shoulder made him stop swimming.
cards.example_zh: 肩膀突然疼痛，他只好停止游泳。

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine

cards.example_en: A student from Pakistan joined our class at the start of term.
cards.example_zh: 学期初，一名来自巴基斯坦的学生加入了我们班。

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.example_en: The patient thanked the nurse after the check-up.
cards.example_zh: 检查结束后，病人向护士道了谢。

cards.scene: 健康医疗 · Health and Medicine
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：意识到；实现
cards.example_en: You will realize your mistake once you check the map.
cards.example_zh: 你一核对地图，就会意识到自己的错误。
